meta.index_type: Teranet–National Bank repeat-sales house price index (June 2005 = 100)
meta.index_caveat: An index of price change, not a price level. Per-city series start later than the array start; leading nulls are dropped rather than back-filled.
meta.endpoint_note: Undocumented JSON endpoint backing housepriceindex.ca charts. Public and stable, but not a contracted API — if it moves, this script is the thing to fix.
